name: TMAG5273 3D Hall (angle CORDIC) - Adafruit A2 breakout
notes: Adafruit page: 2.3 mA active, 5 nA sleep. I2C up to 1 MHz, 12-bit ADC, on-chip CORDIC angle, temp. Board 25.5x17.7x4.6 mm, 1.7-3.6 V (3.3 V logic, VIN reg). A2 range +/-133/266 mT (A1 +/-40/80 mT: better for weak/far magnet). Has wake-and-sleep duty-cycle mode with threshold interrupt (INT pin) = wake-on-change; per TI datasheet ~ single-digit uA average at low sample rate (recalled, verify). Best fit for battery pendant. Angle only 0-360 XY (needs diametric magnet, or axial magnet with off-axis placement).

name: TMAG5273 3D Hall - SparkFun Mini Qwiic breakout
notes: SparkFun page: $7.90, 0.5x1 in board, BACKORDER at time of check. Same chip: 2.3 mA active / 5 nA sleep (Adafruit page), I2C, wake-and-sleep + INT. Standard-size SparkFun board seen at $7.50 in a search snippet only (not verified).

name: TMAG5273A1 bare 3D Hall IC
notes: LCSC live: $1.94/1, $1.68/10, $1.30/100, 343 in stock, SOT-23-6 (2.9x1.6 mm). 1.7-3.6 V, I2C, 12-bit, CORDIC angle. 2.3 mA active, 5 nA sleep, wake-and-sleep mode with interrupt on threshold (wake-on-change) per TI datasheet/Adafruit summary. Other variants (A2, B/C/D) differ by I2C address and range; choose A1 for weak field. Order A1 and A2 for test.

name: AS5600 (I2C/PWM/analog) - Adafruit breakout
notes: Adafruit live: $5.95 (10+ $5.36, 100+ $4.76), in stock. 12-bit, I2C, STEMMA QT. Datasheet (recalled, verify): 6.5 mA nominal, LPM1 3.4 mA, LPM2 1.8 mA, LPM3 ~1.5 mA (polling mode) - NO true sleep, no wake-on-change. 3.3/5 V. Too power-hungry for weeks unless its supply is switched by a load switch/GPIO.

name: AS5600 bare
notes: LCSC live: $1.77/1, $1.57/10, $1.30/100, only 12 in stock. SOIC-8 (~5x4 mm), 3.3/5 V, I2C+PWM/analog, 12-bit. 6.5 mA nominal; LPM modes 1.5-3.4 mA (recalled datasheet, verify); no sleep pin, no wake. Would need power gating (touch-controlled load switch).

name: AS5600L (programmable I2C address)
notes: LCSC live $6.36/1 (100+ $4.56), 436 in stock; markedly pricier than AS5600. Same current profile as AS5600 (6.5 mA nominal, LPM 1.5-3.4 mA, recalled). Only useful if multiple sensors share bus; skip.

name: AS5601 (I2C + A/B incremental)
notes: DigiKey: page shows DISCONTINUED / 0 stock (price $3.29 was a search snippet only). 12-bit, I2C + quadrature, SOIC-8, 3.3/5 V, ~6.5 mA like AS5600. Not recommended (discontinued, no low-power mode).

name: MT6701 magnetic encoder (14-bit) bare
notes: LCSC live: $1.43/1, $1.15/10, $0.89/100, 5,050 in stock, SOP-8 (~5x4 mm), 3.3-5 V, listed supply current 10 mA; DigiKey copy (NOVOSENSE) out of stock, $1.35 @3000. Interfaces: I2C, SSI, ABZ, UVW, PWM/analog. 14-bit (0.02 deg). No sleep or wake mode (always-on ~10 mA per LCSC page; datasheet says ~9 mA typ) -> needs power gating. Also lists CT-STD non-R at $2.04.

name: MT6701 breakout module (generic)
notes: Price NOT verified: Amazon page fetch returned no price; search snippets suggest roughly $9-15 for 1-pack (unverified). I2C/ABZ/PWM 14-bit, ~10 mA always on, 3.3-5 V. Generic boards vary in quality; prefer own PCB with bare chip.

name: AS5048A/B 14-bit bare
notes: DigiKey shows 0 stock, no backorder (single-unit price not shown). TSSOP-14, 3.0-3.6 or 4.5-5.5 V, I2C (B) / SPI (A) + PWM, 14-bit. ~15 mA active, no sleep (recalled). Not recommended for battery.

name: AS5048A eval/adapter board
notes: Price $16.66 taken from a search-result snippet, not a fetched page; stock unverified. SPI, 14-bit, ~15 mA. Hobby alternative: SmallRobots Tindie board $15 (21x17 mm), OUT OF STOCK since Oct 2024.

name: AS5048A SmallRobots encoder board
notes: Tindie live: $15 (1-3), $14 (4+), 21x17 mm, includes cable+magnet, but OUT OF STOCK. SPI 14-bit, ~15 mA active. Reference only.

name: TLE5012B GMR angle sensor (SPI/SSC)
notes: LCSC live: $4.11/1, $3.67/10, $2.70/100, 7,490 in stock, DSO-8 (~5x4 mm). 3.0-5.5 V, SSC (SPI-like) / PWM / incremental, 15-bit, +/-1 deg. ~8-10 mA active (recalled datasheet), no sleep/wake mode. Wants power gating; fine accuracy but poor battery fit.

name: MA730 (MPS) 14-bit angle sensor
notes: DigiKey live: $4.46/1, $3.34/100, 6,395 in stock, 3x3 mm QFN-16, 3.3 V, SPI + PWM, 14-bit. Approx 10-12 mA active (recalled datasheet), no sleep. 52-week lead time on reorder.

name: MA702 (MPS) 12-bit angle sensor
notes: DigiKey live: $4.37/1, $3.27/100, 3x3 mm QFN-16, 3.3 V, SPI/PWM/ABZ, 12-bit, ~10 mA (recalled, ranges by mode). No sleep. Not better than TMAG5273 for battery.

name: Diametric magnet 6x2.5 mm N38
notes: UMAGNETS: packs of 20/50/100 range $4.59 to $12.79 total (which pack is which not shown; per-piece roughly $0.13-$0.23, unverified per-tier). N38, Ni-plated, 3,810 gauss surface, 80 C max. Also Amazon 100-pcs listings, source-robotics single units (prices not seen). Buy 20-pack for test; diametric (radial) magnetization is essential for AS5600/MT6701/AS5048/TMAG5273 angle mode. 4x2 mm variant is also common.

name: Alps EC05E 5mm tiny incremental encoder, 12 PPR detent
notes: DigiKey live: $2.82/1, $1.82/100, 2,889 in stock, 24-wk lead on new orders. 12 PPR quadrature with detents, vertical PCB, 5 V rating (works at 3.3 V), mechanical contacts: zero standby current except pull-ups (use pull-downs/1 MOhm or GPIO enable; wake-on-GPIO-sense works). RELATIVE only. Small (~5-6 mm body, no switch).

name: Alps EC10E 10mm incremental encoder, 12 PPR detent
notes: DigiKey live: $1.04/1, $0.67/100, 2,195 in stock, 28-wk lead. Quadrature 12 PPR w/ detent, vertical THT, 100k cycles. Zero standby current; A/B GPIO can wake nRF5340 (PORT sense). Relative only; cheapest.

name: Bourns PEC09 9mm incremental encoder (12 PPR)
notes: Mouser page fetch TIMED OUT - price not seen. 9 mm, 12 PPR, 12 detents, 5 V, 2-bit gray, knurled shaft. Mechanical, zero standby. Relative only.

name: Panasonic EVQ-WKA001 thumbwheel encoder
notes: OBSOLETE (no longer manufactured; price not shown). SMD side thumbwheel, 15 PPR with detent and switch. Suggest alternatives EVQ-VVD00203B or Alps EC10E. Relative; zero standby.

name: Bourns EAW absolute contacting encoder (ACE-128)
notes: SparkFun live: $10.50, in stock. True absolute 128 positions/rev (7-bit gray), no detents, 360 deg continuous, ~9 mm threaded M9 bushing, 50k rev life. Contacting: needs pull-ups (draws only during read, zero when off; supply voltage not confirmed on page, datasheet 3-5.5 V recalled). Absolute, no wake-on-change but mechanical-only so can be powered/read on demand. Cheapest true absolute; low 128-step resolution.

name: Bourns 3382 SMD rotary position sensor (pot), 10k
notes: DigiKey live: $1.27/1, $0.91/100, 48,452 in stock. 330 deg range, hole-for-shaft, +/-2% linearity. Analog absolute (ADC). At 3.3 V across 10k = 330 uA, gate via GPIO, or use 100k variant for ~33 uA; hard-end-stop only (not continuous 360). Cheap absolute option.

name: PM1105 micro gimbal BLDC motor (12x16 mm)
notes: Copterlab live $22.91 (before shipping). 12x16 mm body (18x16 with AS5048A encoder option), 12 g, 8-12 V, 12.5 ohm, nominal 0.59 A, stall 0.92 A, 0.01 Nm. Smallest gimbal BLDC found; Amazon/Alibaba listings exist (price not verified). NOT plausible for a coin-cell/LiPo pendant: holding a detent draws hundreds of mA (12V-rated; at ~3-4 V torque is far lower), plus needs a boost or 5V rail; only viable as a short-burst haptic. Bigger 2204/2804 (28 mm) are worse. Also need separate absolute sensor.

name: TMC6300 breakout (SparkFun)
notes: SparkFun live: $17.95, in stock. 2-11 V, 2 A peak (1.4 A RMS), 0.8x0.6 in board. Page states operating 7 mA, standby <50 nA (motor current extra). Six PWM inputs, needs FOC firmware on nRF5340. Fine when idle but motor hold draws 100s of mA -> not for weeks-long battery.

name: TMC6300-LA bare driver
notes: LCSC live: $6.37/1, $4.47/100, currently OUT OF STOCK. QFN-20 3x3 mm, 2-11 V, 2 A peak, ~50 nA standby. Search snippet earlier suggested $2.60 but the fetched page shows $6.37 - use the page value. DRV8316/MP6543 not priced (not researched).

name: Azoteq IQS228B capacitive touch/proximity
notes: DigiKey live: $0.42/1, $0.2266/100, 32,130 in stock, TSOT-23-6, 1.76-3.6 V, 6.45 uA (DigiKey) . Proximity-only, digital output drives knob-sensor load switch/GPIO wake. Also IQS227AS is OBSOLETE. IQS231 not priced (eval kit $41.79 snippet only). Best wake IC: micro-amp always-on.

name: Microchip AT42QT1010 single-key touch
notes: LCSC live: $1.39/1, $1.14/10, $0.86/100, 1,208 in stock, SOT-23-6, 1.8-5.5 V. Digital output, one cap needed. Idle current higher than IQS228B (datasheet ~ tens of uA at 1.8-3V default; recalled, verify). Alternative: nRF5340 has no capacitive-touch peripheral; RC charge-time with COMP/GPIO or a capsense pad on a GPIO with 1-5 MOhm resistor, sampled every 100-200 ms from low-power timer (about 1-3 uA average) is free but noisier.
